posts.query: linkedin.com/posts hiring business systems analyst dubai
posts.author: Lakshmi Prasad
posts.content:
🚀 We're Hiring: Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst
📍 Location: Dubai, UAE
⏳ Experience: 5-8 Years

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst to join a leading aviation client in Dubai and drive requirements management for the #Disruption & #Welfare Management Solution within Airport IT.

Key Responsibilities:
✅ Collaborate with Airport Services, Reservations, NCC, Customer Experience, and Finance teams to gather and manage business requirements.
✅ Define, document, and deliver capabilities supporting passenger handling during flight disruptions.
✅ Work on welfare management processes including accommodation, transportation, meal vouchers, compensation, and customer communications.
✅ Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements and support end-to-end solution delivery.

Required Skills:
✔ 5-8 years of Business Analysis experience.
✔ Strong knowledge of Passenger Service Systems (PSS) and Departure Control Systems (DCS).
✔ Experience in requirements gathering, process mapping, stakeholder management, and solution design.
✔ Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred:
✈ Proven experience in #airline_disruption management, passenger recovery, welfare management, or #airline_operations solutions.
✈ Exposure to aviation, airport operations, airline systems, or travel domain projects.

📩 Interested candidates can share their updated CV to Lakshmi@asianglobalinfotech.com and mention in Subject line as BA_Airline Disruption
